lines.text: The LORD announces one more plague, after which Pharaoh will drive Israel out, and tells the people to ask for silver and gold.
Moses says that about midnight every firstborn son in Egypt will die, but not even a dog will snarl at Israel.
On the tenth day each man is to select a lamb, an unblemished year-old male, to keep until the fourth day.
The LORD tells them to put the lamb's blood on the doorframes, and when He sees it, He will pass over them.
